name: Flatly
description_en:
Flatly is a hosted service for refreshing business datasets in spreadsheets and cloud files. Jobs configure the dataset, destination, columns, format and schedule.

It favors bulk dataset replication over per-record event automation.
description_zh:
Flatly 是把业务数据集持续刷新到表格和云文件的托管服务。Job 配置数据集、目标、列、格式与调度，

重点是批量数据集复制。

core_features.explanation_en: Refresh configured datasets on a job schedule.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按 job 调度刷新所选数据集。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose a documented target and its supported format.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择文档列出的目标及其支持格式。

use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Authorize the source and destination for one trial job.
steps.zh: 为一个试验 job 授权源与目标。

steps.en: Check output fields and repeated-run results in a separate destination.
steps.zh: 在独立目标检查输出字段及重复运行结果。

steps.en: Compare file, cell and subconnection needs with the plan.
steps.zh: 把文件、cell 与子连接需求同套餐比较。

items.en: The first-100-row trial cannot establish full-volume completeness.
items.zh: 前 100 行试用不能证明全量完整性。

items.en: Destination listing is not verification of every source/format pair.
items.zh: 列入目标目录不代表每种源与格式组合均已核实。

sources.title: Flatly | Comprehensive Data Sync Made Effortless
sources.research_notes_en: Public FAQ and product page read before a later homepage 403; bulk dataset refresh, logs and vendor security statements distinguished from tests.

sources.title: Pricing – Flatly
sources.research_notes_en: Monthly plan/file/cell/subconnection limits, non-cumulative counting, one seat and first-100-row trial read; frequency asterisk unresolved.

sources.title: Data Destinations — Flatly
sources.research_notes_en: Destination catalog read; spreadsheet, cloud storage and warehouse entries have different format counts, not universal support.

sources.research_notes_en: Proprietary service license, no source-code grant, account-sharing restriction, auto-renewal and external-service conditions read.

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Full datasets rather than individual event records
sections.title_zh: 完整数据集与单条事件记录的区别
sections.en: The FAQ describes full GET/LIST-ALL extraction. Advanced custom blending is not offered, although some precombined datasets exist. This makes the product worth evaluating for a regularly refreshed analytical extract; it does not establish a general application-action builder.
sections.zh: FAQ 描述完整 GET／LIST-ALL 提取；暂不提供高级自定义混合，部分预组合数据集除外。可据此评估定期刷新的分析导出，但不能据此认定具备通用应用动作构建能力。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the delivered file, not just the connection
sections.title_zh: 验收交付文件，而不只看连接
sections.en: The catalog includes Google Sheets, Excel Online, S3, BigQuery and SFTP, with target-dependent formats. A proposed trial: export support tickets to a separate sheet, preserve ticket IDs and compare changed urgency values after another run. Check duplicates, missing rows and downstream formulas. This example was not executed; the destination list does not prove source-specific fields, pagination completeness or overwrite behavior.
sections.zh: 目标目录包括 Google Sheets、Excel Online、S3、BigQuery 与 SFTP，格式随目标而异。建议试验：把支持工单导出到独立表，保留工单 ID，第二次运行后对照紧急度变化，并检查重复、缺行和下游公式。本文未执行该例，目标列表不能证明具体源字段、分页完整性或覆盖行为。

sections.title_en: Use logs to check refresh failures
sections.en: The product page describes run logs, progress and success/failure notifications. When access expires or a source fails, inspect the recorded result and the destination before relying on another refresh. Retry intervals and permanent-error recovery were not verified. Vendor reliability percentages are not adopted as measured results.
sections.zh: 产品页描述运行日志、进度及成功／失败通知。访问过期或源失败时，应检查记录结果及目标，再依赖下一次刷新。本次未确认重试间隔与永久错误恢复，也未把厂商可靠性百分比当作实测结果。

sections.title_en: Count cells per file and automatic files separately
sections.title_zh: 分别计算每文件 cell 与自动文件数
sections.en: Paperweight is $19/month for two automatic files and 1M cells/file; Rollingpin $49 for ten and 10M; Lawnroller $99 for twenty and 100M. Subconnection allowances are 10/20/60. Repeated runs do not accumulate the cell allowance. Accounting integrations and product support start at Lawnroller. Plans show one seat; the 14-day no-card trial exports only the first 100 rows. Listed frequencies carry an unexplained asterisk, so confirm the effective interval.
sections.zh: Paperweight 每月 $19，含两个自动文件、每文件 100 万 cell；Rollingpin 为 $49、十个及 1000 万；Lawnroller 为 $99、二十个及一亿。子连接额度依次为 10／20／60，重复运行不累计 cell 额度。会计集成与产品支持从 Lawnroller 起提供。各方案列一个席位；免信用卡的 14 天试用仅导出前 100 行。频率带未解释星号，应确认实际间隔。

sections.title_en: Hosted access has license and security boundaries
sections.title_zh: 托管访问有许可与安全边界
sections.en: Terms grant limited service use without source-code rights and restrict account sharing. They also describe subscription renewal and possible service interruption. The vendor says business data is transient while connection information is retained; it explicitly says Flatly itself is not SOC certified. Infrastructure-provider certification does not establish product certification. These are documentation statements, not an infrastructure audit.
sections.zh: 条款授予有限服务使用权，不授予源码权利，并限制共享账号；也说明订阅续期及可能中断。厂商称业务数据临时流经系统，连接信息会保留，并明确表示 Flatly 自身未获 SOC 认证。基础设施提供商认证不等于产品认证。这些是文档表述，不是基础设施审计。

sections.title_en: A narrow export task is easier to qualify
sections.title_zh: 限定导出任务更容易判断适用性
sections.en: Evaluate one exact source/destination pair and the delivered schema before expanding. Multi-person administration, complex joins or transaction-triggered writes need separate confirmation or another product evaluation. Assign responsibility for connection renewal, stale extracts and downstream consumers; a green job alone is insufficient acceptance.
sections.zh: 扩展前先评估一个明确的源目标组合及交付 schema。多人管理、复杂联接或事务触发写入，需另外确认或评估其他产品。应明确连接续期、过期导出及下游使用者的负责人，绿色任务状态本身不足以完成验收。

seo.title_en: Flatly: Dataset Refresh, File Limits and Subscription Pricing
seo.title_zh: Flatly：数据集刷新、文件限制与订阅定价
seo.description_en: Evaluate Flatly bulk exports, spreadsheet destinations, cell counting, trial limits and hosted-service boundaries.
seo.description_zh: 评估 Flatly 批量导出、表格目标、cell 计数、试用限制及托管服务边界。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate a Flatly data export and its subscription limits.
seo.query_basis: Editorial questions from primary-source research; search demand, rankings and AI citations not measured.

research_gaps.en: Source catalog and API returned HTTP 403; knowledge-base fetch failed. Homepage was readable earlier but later returned 403. No bypass attempted. Connector-specific setup, pagination, overwrite behavior and retry policy remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 源目录与 API 返回 HTTP 403，知识库读取失败；首页先前可读，随后返回 403。未绕过限制。连接器具体设置、分页、覆盖行为及重试策略仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: Frequency asterisks, higher-plan prices, production reliability, security implementation and UI languages remain unresolved or untested.
research_gaps.zh: 频率星号含义、更高套餐价格、生产可靠性、安全实现及界面语言仍未确认或实测。
